name: High-severity support case on my account
description: A P1 or P2 support case is opened and still open on an account where you are on the account team. P1 is critical: production, or an executive or production dashboard, is down with no workaround. P2 is high: degraded, with a workaround. Only P1 can skip quiet hours and digests (PRD L5).
title: {severity} support case at {account}
explain: Fired because {account}, an account on your account team, has an open {severity} support case: "{subject}", opened {when}.
